Primary grid squares of the census grid statistics

Source: R/census-grid-get.R
census_grid_primary_grids.Rd

census_grid_primary_grids() lists the primary grid squares (80 km) with land, the units in which the tables of census_grid_get() are downloaded. It is used by the bundled pipeline.

Usage

census_grid_primary_grids()

Value

A character vector of four-digit codes.

Examples

census_grid_primary_grids()
#>   [1] "3036" "3622" "3623" "3624" "3631" "3641" "3653" "3724" "3725" "3741"
